applies_why: The judge marks Matthew 1:20 UNDERDETERMINED because the two sides give different senses, which is the situation K-S2 governs.
quote: D2 vs C1 (Matthew 1:20): UNDERDETERMINED -- Challenger answered the conception agency as covenant presence in [DR3] and defender answered the physical source in the womb in [CR2] and [CR3].
rule_words: That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side. A verse that carries two senses at once is not open. Both senses stand.
room: A verse that carries two senses at once is not open. Both senses stand — I weighed reading the two Matthew 1:20 senses as an open UNDERDETERMINED conflict versus treating both senses as standing.
why: The judge labels Matthew 1:20 UNDERDETERMINED on the basis that each side supplies a different sense, but K-S2 says a verse carrying two senses is not open and both senses stand.
